name: Whole Wheat Penne with Roasted Vegetables and Ricotta
steps: Roast the vegetables with oil and garlic at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Toss with the vegetables, ricotta and basil.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Broccoli
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Warm the garlic and pepper flakes in oil.
Toss together with parmesan and parsley.

name: Chickpea Pasta with Pesto, Tomatoes and Chicken
steps: Cook the chickpea pasta and grill the sliced chicken.
Toss with the pesto, tomatoes and spinach.
Top with parmesan.

name: Lentil Pasta with Turkey Bolognese
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion, carrot and garlic.
Simmer with the marinara and seasoning 20 minutes.
Serve over the cooked lentil pasta with parmesan.

name: Fettuccine with Mushroom Cream Sauce
steps: Brown the mushrooms in oil with garlic and thyme.
Add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss with the cooked pasta.

name: Pasta Puttanesca with Tuna
steps: Melt the anchovy and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers and pepper flakes and simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in the tuna and the cooked pasta.

name: Baked Penne with Spinach, Ricotta and Marinara
steps: Cook the pasta slightly firm and mix with the wilted spinach, ricotta, garlic and marinara.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Cacio e Pepe-Style Pasta with Peas
steps: Cook the pasta, saving a cup of its water.
Toss with butter, pepper, parmesan and a splash of the water until creamy.
Fold in the warm peas.

name: Sausage and Peppers Penne
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Add the onion, peppers and garlic, then the marinara, and simmer 12 minutes.
Toss with the cooked penne.

name: Shrimp and Asparagus Pasta in Lemon Butter
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the asparagus for the last 2 minutes.
Sauté the garlic in butter and cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Toss with lemon and parsley.

name: Chicken Alfredo-Style Zucchini Noodle Bowls
steps: Sear and slice the chicken.
Simmer the garlic, cream and parmesan.
Toss the zucchini noodles briefly in the sauce and top with chicken.

name: Whole Wheat Spaghetti with Lentil Marinara
steps: Simmer the cooked lentils in the marinara with the onion and garlic.
Serve over the pasta with basil.

name: Macaroni Salad with Peas and Yogurt Dressing
steps: Cook and cool the macaroni.
Whisk the yogurt, mayo, mustard and vinegar.
Fold everything together and chill.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad with Olives and Lemon
steps: Cook and cool the pasta.
Toss with the tuna, olives, tomatoes, cucumber, lemon, oil and parsley.

name: Farro Risotto-Style with Mushrooms and Parmesan
steps: Soften the onion and mushrooms in oil with garlic.
Add the farro and wine, then ladle in the broth as it absorbs.
Finish with parmesan.

name: Barley Mushroom Soup with Thyme
steps: Soften the vegetables and garlic.
Add the barley, broth and thyme and simmer 35 minutes.

name: Bulgur Pilaf with Chickpeas and Spinach
steps: Soften the onion with the cumin in oil.
Add the cooked bulgur and chickpeas and heat through.
Wilt in the spinach and finish with lemon.

name: Quinoa Stuffed Acorn-Style Squash with Cranberries
steps: Roast the halved squash.
Mix the quinoa with sautéed onion, cranberries, pecans and sage.
Fill the squash and bake 10 minutes.

name: Brown Rice and Black Bean Burritos in a Bowl
steps: Warm the rice, beans and corn.
Build bowls and top with salsa, avocado, cilantro and lime.

name: Shrimp and Grits with Andouille-Style Chicken Sausage
steps: Cook the grits with the cheddar.
Brown the sausage, pepper and onion, then the seasoned shrimp.
Spoon over the grits.

name: Creamy Polenta-Style Grits with Mushrooms and Spinach
steps: Cook the grits and stir in the parmesan.
Brown the mushrooms with garlic, wilt the spinach.
Spoon over the grits.

name: Baked Eggs in Marinara over Grits
steps: Spoon the grits into ramekins and top with marinara.
Crack in an egg each and bake at 375°F for 12 minutes.
Finish with parmesan and basil.

name: Egg Noodle Chicken Paprikash
steps: Brown the chicken and soften the onion and pepper with the paprika.
Add the broth and paste and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and serve over the noodles.

name: Garlic Shrimp Zucchini Noodle Scampi Bowls
steps: Sauté the garlic in oil and cook the shrimp 3 minutes.
Toss with the zucchini noodles, lemon and pepper flakes.
Top with parmesan.

name: Turkey Meatball Soup with Tiny Pasta and Spinach
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan and garlic and roll tiny meatballs.
Simmer in the broth with the carrot 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and spinach and cook until the pasta is tender.

name: Peanut Butter Oat Cookies
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the peanut butter, egg and vanilla.
Stir in the oats, cinnamon and baking powder.
Bake fourteen cookies at 350°F for 12 minutes.

name: Coconut Almond Flour Shortbread
steps: Mix everything into a dough.
Press into rounds on a tray.
Bake at 325°F for 14 to 15 minutes.

name: Date and Walnut Energy Bars
steps: Process the dates, walnuts, oats, almond butter, cinnamon and chia until sticky.
Press into a lined pan and chill; cut into ten bars.

name: Protein Granola Bars with Peanut Butter
steps: Mix the peanut butter, egg white, sweetener and vanilla; fold in the oats, protein and chips.
Press into a lined pan.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes and cut into twelve bars.

name: Cinnamon Apple Oat Bars
steps: Cook the diced apple with cinnamon until soft.
Mix the oats, butter, egg, walnuts and sugar; press half into a pan.
Spread the apple and crumble the rest on top.
Bake at 350°F for 28 minutes.

name: Flourless Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Blondies
steps: Blend the chickpeas, peanut butter, egg, vanilla, baking powder and sweetener until smooth.
Fold in the chips.
Bake in a lined pan at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Dark Chocolate Raspberry Mug Cake
steps: Whisk everything except the berries into two mugs.
Drop in the raspberries.
Microwave 90 seconds.

name: Lemon Cream Cheese Fat-Bomb Bites
steps: Whip the cream cheese, butter, lemon, sweetener and vanilla.
Roll into twelve balls in the coconut and chill.

name: Mango Lime Frozen Yogurt Pops
steps: Blend everything and pour into moulds.
Freeze 4 hours.

name: Pineapple Mint Granita
steps: Blend the fruit with mint, lime and water.
Freeze in a shallow dish, scraping with a fork every 45 minutes.

name: Chocolate Chia Seed Pudding with Raspberries
steps: Whisk the chia, almond milk, cocoa, sweetener and vanilla; chill 4 hours.
Top with raspberries.

name: Trail Mix with Nuts, Seeds and Dark Chocolate
steps: Combine everything in a jar.

name: Baked Cinnamon Pear Chips
steps: Slice the pears thin and dust with cinnamon.
Bake at 225°F for 80 to 90 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Fruit Dip with Apple Slices
steps: Whisk the yogurt, peanut butter, cinnamon and vanilla.
Serve with the apple slices.

name: Protein Hot Chocolate
steps: Warm the milk and whisk in the cocoa, sweetener and vanilla.
Off the heat, whisk in the protein.

name: Vanilla Chai Smoothie with Banana
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Raspberry Lime Sparkling Water
steps: Muddle the raspberries with the lime and mint.
Top with sparkling water over ice.

name: Lemon Ginger Hot Water
steps: Steep the sliced ginger in hot water 5 minutes.
Add the lemon.

name: Iced Hibiscus Tea
steps: Brew a strong tea, chill, and add the lime, stevia and cinnamon.

name: Almond Milk Matcha-Style Green Latte
steps: Warm the almond milk with vanilla and sweetener and froth.
Pour over the strong green tea.

name: Cranberry Orange Spritzer
steps: Blend the cranberries and orange with a little water, strain.
Top with sparkling water and stevia.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend the banana, yogurt, peanut butter and milk thick.
Top with oats and strawberries.

name: Berry Chia Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend the berries, yogurt and almond milk thick.
Top with chia, almonds and coconut.

name: Blueberry Oat Breakfast Bars
steps: Mix the oats, eggs, milk, cinnamon and baking powder; fold in the berries and walnuts.
Bake in a pan at 350°F for 25 minutes and cut into bars.

name: Cottage Cheese Berry Breakfast Bowl
steps: Top the cottage cheese with berries, almonds and chia and dust with cinnamon.

name: Spiced Pumpkin Breakfast Cookies
steps: Mix everything.
Scoop twelve cookies.
Bake at 350°F for 14 minutes.

name: Black Bean Burger on a Whole Bun
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg and spices and form four patties.
Pan-fry 5 minutes a side.
Build on toasted buns with tomato, lettuce and avocado.

name: Mushroom Swiss Turkey Burger
steps: Shape the turkey into four patties and grill 6 minutes a side.
Sauté the mushrooms, onion and garlic.
Top with Swiss and mushrooms on toasted buns.

name: Pesto Veggie Tortilla Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas, spread with pesto and top with the vegetables and mozzarella.
Bake at 425°F for 8 minutes.

name: Cauliflower-Crust Flatbread with Tomato, Mozzarella and Basil
steps: Steam, squeeze and mix the cauliflower rice with the egg, parmesan and seasoning; press into a crust and bake 15 minutes at 425°F.
Top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more.
Finish with basil.

name: Ham and Pineapple Tortilla Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas and top with marinara, mozzarella, ham and pineapple.
Bake at 425°F for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Pita with Apple Crunch
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with diced apple, celery, yogurt and mustard.
Stuff into the pitas.

name: Salmon Burger on a Bun with Dill Yogurt
steps: Chop the salmon and mix with egg, oat bran, mustard and half the dill; form patties.
Pan-sear 4 minutes a side.
Serve on buns with dill-spiked yogurt and lettuce.

name: Chili Cheese Dog with Turkey Sausage
steps: Simmer the beans with the sauce, chili powder and onion.
Grill the sausages and serve in buns topped with chili and cheddar.

name: Banh Mi-Style Chicken Sandwich on a Bun
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Quick-pickle the carrot and daikon in lime.
Build on buns with mayo, cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

name: Falafel Burger Bowls with Tahini
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, parsley, oat flour, garlic and cumin and form patties; bake 15 minutes at 425°F.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and water.
Serve over the salad vegetables.

name: Zucchini Gratin with Parmesan and Thyme
steps: Layer the sliced zucchini in an oiled dish.
Pour over the milk whisked with egg, garlic and thyme and top with parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 28 to 30 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Gratin with Gruyere-Style Swiss
steps: Steam the florets until just tender.
Warm the milk with garlic and nutmeg and melt in half the cheese.
Pour over the cauliflower, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Scalloped Sweet Potatoes with Thyme
steps: Layer the sliced sweet potatoes in a dish.
Pour over the warm milk with garlic and thyme and dot with butter and parmesan.
Bake covered at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Creamed Kale with Garlic
steps: Wilt the kale with garlic.
Stir in the cream cheese, milk and parmesan until creamy.

name: Garlic Mushroom Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the mushrooms and garlic in oil.
Add the cauliflower rice and cook 5 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

name: Rosemary Roasted Turnips
steps: Toss the cubed turnips with oil, rosemary, garlic and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.

name: Spaghetti Squash Gratin with Spinach
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Mix with the wilted spinach, ricotta and garlic.
Top with cheeses and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

name: Butternut Squash Mash with Sage
steps: Roast the squash until soft.
Mash with butter, sage, nutmeg and milk.

name: Stuffed Zucchini with Quinoa and Feta
steps: Scoop the halved zucchini.
Mix the quinoa with the chopped flesh, tomatoes, onion, oregano and feta.
Fill and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Cheesy Eggplant Parmesan Rounds
steps: Roast the eggplant rounds brushed with oil.
Top each with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 10 minutes more and finish with parmesan and basil.

name: Loaded Sweet Potato Skins with Black Beans
steps: Bake the sweet potato halves and scoop out most of the flesh.
Fill with beans and cheddar and bake 10 minutes.
Top with yogurt, salsa and cilantro.

name: Turkey Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus Bundles
steps: Wrap bundles of asparagus in turkey bacon.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.

name: Salsa Verde Chicken Roll-Ups
steps: Pound the chicken, layer with spinach and cheese, roll and secure.
Sear, then bake in the salsa verde at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Lemon Herb Turkey Cutlets with Green Beans
steps: Pound and season the cutlets and sear in oil, 3 minutes a side.
Steam the green beans.
Finish the cutlets with lemon and herbs.

name: Chicken Thighs with Olives and Tomatoes
steps: Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, tomatoes, olives, oregano and wine and braise covered 30 minutes.

name: Spice-Rubbed Turkey Tenderloin with Roasted Carrots
steps: Rub the turkey with oil and spices.
Roast on the carrots at 400°F for 35 minutes and rest before slicing.

name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Dressing
steps: Whisk everything together and chill.

name: Lemon Tahini Dressing
steps: Whisk the tahini, lemon, garlic, oil and water until smooth.

name: Balsamic Vinaigrette
steps: Whisk everything together.

name: Avocado Cilantro Lime Crema
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Fresh Tomato Salsa
steps: Chop everything finely and mix.

name: Homemade Marinara
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes; finish with basil.

name: Dairy-Free Basil Pesto
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Quick Guacamole with Lime
steps: Mash the avocado and fold in the rest.

name: Low-Sugar Barbecue Sauce
steps: Simmer everything 15 minutes until thick.

name: Cucumber Dill Tzatziki
steps: Stir the yogurt with grated, squeezed cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon and oil.

name: White Bean and Rosemary Dip
steps: Blend the beans with rosemary, garlic, lemon and oil.
Serve with carrot and celery.

name: Everything Bagel Egg Cups
steps: Dollop cream cheese into six muffin cups with the spinach.
Pour in the eggs and sprinkle with seasoning.
Bake at 350°F for 18 minutes.

name: Avocado Breakfast Bowl with Soft Eggs
steps: Soft-boil the eggs.
Arrange avocado, tomatoes and beans in bowls and top with the eggs, lime and cilantro.

name: Turkey Sausage and Spinach Scramble
steps: Brown the sausage in oil.
Scramble in the eggs and spinach and top with cheddar.

name: Apple Pie Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, cinnamon and vanilla in a jar; chill overnight.
Top with diced apple and walnuts.

name: Sweet Potato Toast with Egg and Avocado
steps: Slice the sweet potato lengthwise and toast until tender.
Top with mashed avocado, a fried egg, chives and pepper flakes.

name: Mushroom and Swiss Omelet
steps: Brown the mushrooms with thyme.
Cook the eggs in butter, fill with mushrooms and Swiss and fold.

name: Chicken Apple Breakfast Sausage Patties
steps: Mix everything and form eight patties.
Pan-fry 4 to 5 minutes a side.

name: Yogurt Pancake Dippers with Berry Sauce
steps: Whisk the yogurt and eggs, fold in the oat flour and baking powder, and cook small pancakes.
Warm the berries into a quick sauce and serve for dipping.

name: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Stew
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, potatoes and thyme and simmer 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Barley Soup with Leeks
steps: Simmer the chicken, leek, carrot, celery and thyme in the broth 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the barley and cook until tender, about 25 minutes.

name: Spicy Black Bean and Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic with the spices.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 18 minutes; blend half and finish with lime.

name: Egg and Spinach Drop Soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer and add the spinach.
Stream in the beaten eggs and parmesan and stir into ribbons.

name: Salmon and Corn Chowder
steps: Soften the onion and add the broth, potatoes and corn; simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk and the cubed salmon and cook 8 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Moroccan Chickpea and Vegetable Stew
steps: Soften the onion with the spices.
Add the vegetables, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth and simmer 28 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Garlic Herb Chicken Breasts Stuffed with Spinach
steps: Mix the wilted spinach, cream cheese, garlic and parmesan.
Cut a pocket in each breast and fill.
Sear, then bake at 400°F for 22 minutes.

name: Mustard Yogurt Salmon with Green Beans
steps: Mix the mustard, yogurt, lemon and garlic and spread on the salmon.
Roast at 400°F with the green beans for 12 to 14 minutes.

name: Cajun Turkey Meatloaf Muffins
steps: Mix everything but the paste and press into a muffin tin.
Top with the paste and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
steps: Sear the sliced steak in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables, garlic and ginger.
Return the beef with soy sauce and serve over rice.

name: Sheet Pan Pork Chops with Apples and Brussels Sprouts
steps: Brush the chops with mustard and set on a tray with the apple and sprouts tossed in oil and thyme.
Roast at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Mediterranean Baked Cod with Tomatoes and Capers
steps: Set the cod on a tray with the tomatoes, capers, olives and garlic.
Drizzle with oil and oregano and bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
